accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II:

List-I (Post)

a. President of India
b. Speaker of the Lok Sabha
c. Chief Minister
 d. Governor

List-II (First woman to hold the post)

i. Sarojini Naidu
 ii. Sucheta Kripalani
 iii. Pratibha Patil
 iv. Meira Kumar

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
o: a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i
a-iv, b-iii, c-i, d-ii
a-iii, b-ii, c-iv, d-i
a-i, b-iv, c-ii, d-iii
accepted.x: Pratibha Patil was the first woman President, Meira Kumar the first woman Lok Sabha Speaker, Sucheta Kripalani the first woman Chief Minister, and Sarojini Naidu the first woman Governor.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes containing a swapped office-holder.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:

1. Pratibha Patil — President of India — 2007
2. Meira Kumar — Lok Sabha Speaker — 2009
3. Sucheta Kripalani — Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh — 1963
4. Sarojini Naidu — Governor of Uttar Pradesh — 1947

Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
o: 1 and 2 only
1, 2 and 3 only
1, 3 and 4 only
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. These were the years associated with the first women to hold the respective offices.
accepted.tq: Check each office-year pair independently before selecting the combination.

accepted.s: The study by Chattopadhyay and Duflo (2004) examined the effect of women’s leadership in village governance by using which method?
o: Random reservation of pradhan posts in West Bengal and Rajasthan
Rotation of Lok Sabha constituencies reserved for women
Census-based selection of women sarpanches in Andhra Pradesh
Nomination of women pradhans by the Union Government in all States
accepted.x: Chattopadhyay and Duflo used the random reservation of pradhan posts in West Bengal and Rajasthan to study the effects of women’s political leadership.
accepted.tq: Identify the distinctive research design and the two States attached to it.
accepted.sec: Studies on women sarpanches - Chattopadhyay-Duflo, proxy representation

accepted.s: According to the findings associated with the Chattopadhyay-Duflo study, women leaders invested more in which of the following?
o: Military infrastructure and border roads exclusively
Goods and facilities requested by women, including drinking water and roads
Only administrative buildings and police infrastructure
Industrial estates and export-processing zones
accepted.x: Women leaders invested more in public goods that women specifically requested, notably drinking water and roads.
accepted.tq: Apply the study’s finding to the type of public goods selected by women leaders.
accepted.sec: Studies on women sarpanches - Chattopadhyay-Duflo, proxy representation

accepted.s: The term “sarpanch-pati” refers to a situation in which:
o: A male relative exercises the office elected to a woman representative
The husband of a male sarpanch receives a reserved Panchayat post
A woman sarpanch is appointed by the District Collector instead of being elected
A former sarpanch automatically becomes the adviser to every woman sarpanch
accepted.x: “Sarpanch-pati” denotes proxy representation in which a male relative exercises the office formally held by an elected woman.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the elected office-holder and the person informally exercising the office.
accepted.sec: Studies on women sarpanches - Chattopadhyay-Duflo, proxy representation

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding proxy representation in women-led Panchayats:

1. Evaluation studies find that proxy representation declines markedly in a second term.
2. Proxies, intimidation and online trolling continue to be barriers.
3. Proxy representation means that the elected woman is legally replaced by a male relative.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is incorrect because proxy representation is an informal exercise of the office by a male relative; it does not legally replace the elected woman.
accepted.tq: Separate the empirical finding from the legally incorrect extreme claim.
accepted.sec: Studies on women sarpanches - Chattopadhyay-Duflo, proxy representation

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs of laws constitutes the principal legal shield specifically mentioned for protection against atrocities and discrimination involving Dalit and tribal communities?
o: The SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955
The Representation of the People Act, 1951 and the Panchayats Act, 1992
The National Commission for Women Act, 1990 and the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961
The Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 and the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015
accepted.x: The relevant legal safeguards identified are the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955.
accepted.tq: Match each law with the rights-protection issue it directly addresses.
accepted.sec: Dalit and tribal representatives - discrimination and atrocities

accepted.s: The SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act referred to in the context of protection of Dalit and tribal representatives was enacted in:
accepted.x: The Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act was enacted in 1989.
accepted.tq: Use the year distinction between the 1955 civil-rights law and the 1989 atrocities law.
accepted.sec: Dalit and tribal representatives - discrimination and atrocities

accepted.s: Bokkasam Palem, located in Srikalahasti mandal of Tirupati, is associated with which achievement?
o: It received the first national award for tribal self-governance
It became the first girls’ Panchayat in India
It was ranked first nationally among women-friendly Panchayats
It was the first Panchayat to introduce a BC-women sub-quota
accepted.x: Bokkasam Palem in Srikalahasti mandal of Tirupati ranked first nationally among women-friendly Panchayats under the Deendayal Upadhyay Panchayat Satat Vikas Awards.
accepted.tq: Link the place, administrative location and award-related achievement precisely.
accepted.sec: AP examples - women-led panchayats, Mahila Sabhas

accepted.s: Bokkasam Palem received national recognition under which award framework?
o: Nari Shakti Puraskar
Gandhi Peace and Rural Development Awards
Panchayat Empowerment and Accountability Incentive Scheme
Deendayal Upadhyay Panchayat Satat Vikas Awards
accepted.x: Its recognition as the leading women-friendly Panchayat was under the Deendayal Upadhyay Panchayat Satat Vikas Awards.
accepted.tq: Use the exact official award name; nearby welfare awards are distractors.
accepted.sec: AP examples - women-led panchayats, Mahila Sabhas

accepted.s: What percentage of seats is reserved for women in Andhra Pradesh local bodies, as specified in the context of women-led Panchayats?
o: 33 per cent
40 per cent
50 per cent
55 per cent
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh provides 50 per cent reservation for women in local bodies.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the State-level local-body figure from the constitutional one-third floor.
accepted.sec: AP examples - women-led panchayats, Mahila Sabhas

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding reservation and representation in local bodies and legislatures:

1. Local bodies have a constitutional one-third floor for women’s reservation.
2. Half reservation for women exists in 19 States and Union Territories.
3. In legislatures, one-third reservation for women is to operate only after delimitation.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
1 and 3 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: local bodies have a one-third floor, half reservation operates in 19 States and Union Territories, and legislative reservation is linked to post-delimitation operation.
accepted.tq: Compare the different commencement conditions for local-body and legislative reservation.

accepted.s: Local-body quotas are described as the working model for which constitutional amendment concerning women’s representation?
o: 105th Amendment
74th Amendment
73rd Amendment
106th Amendment
accepted.x: The existing experience of local-body quotas is described as the working model for the 106th Amendment concerning women’s representation in legislatures.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the earlier local-governance amendments from the later legislative-reservation amendment.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the representation of women among Panchayat members?
o: Women constitute more than three-fourths of all Panchayat members.
Women constitute nearly half of all Panchayat members.
Women constitute nearly one-fourth of all Panchayat members.
Women constitute nearly one-third of all Panchayat members.
accepted.x: Women are nearly half of all Panchayat members, reflecting the effect of local-body reservation.
accepted.tq: Use the approximate share carefully; do not convert “nearly half” into an exact percentage.

accepted.s: The 131st Amendment Bill was reported to have been defeated in:
o: April 2025
August 2026
April 2026
April 2024
accepted.x: The 131st Amendment Bill was reported as defeated in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Check the year and month together because nearby current-affairs dates are confusable.

accepted.s: Women’s groups demanded the removal of which condition attached to women’s legislative reservation?
o: The Census-delimitation condition
The condition of reservation only in urban local bodies
The condition of approval by all State Legislatures
The condition of prior approval by the Election Commission
accepted.x: Women’s groups demanded removal of the Census-delimitation condition, including during the Monsoon Session.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific procedural condition under debate rather than a general approval requirement.

accepted.s: The criticism that bundling women’s quota with delimitation may provide political cover relates principally to:
o: Abolishing reservation in local bodies
Replacing elected representatives with nominated members
Reducing the number of Panchayats
Reallocating seats
accepted.x: The criticism is that linking the quota with delimitation may serve as political cover for reallocating seats.
accepted.tq: Connect the criticism to its stated institutional consequence—seat reallocation.

accepted.s: If the expansion under discussion takes the total number of seats to approximately 816–850, the number of southern seats is projected to rise from 129 to approximately:
accepted.x: The projected number of southern seats would rise from 129 to 195, while the southern share would remain 23.8 per cent.
accepted.tq: Read the before-and-after figures together and distinguish seat count from percentage share.

accepted.s: With reference to the proposed seat expansion, which of the following is correct?
o: Southern seats fall to 129 while their share rises to 50 per cent.
Southern seats rise to 195 while retaining a 23.8 per cent share.
Southern seats remain at 129 while the total rises to 816–850.
Southern seats rise to 195 and their share rises to 40 per cent.
accepted.x: The projection is an increase in southern seats from 129 to 195, while their share remains 23.8 per cent.
accepted.tq: Separate an absolute increase in seats from an unchanged proportional share.

accepted.s: Which of the following demands has been raised by the Andhra Pradesh Congress and BC groups in relation to women’s reservation?
o: A complete abolition of local-body reservation
A reduction of women’s reservation to one-third in Andhra Pradesh
A separate BC-women sub-quota
Reservation exclusively for women from Scheduled Tribes
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Congress and BC groups have demanded a sub-quota for BC women.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific sub-quota demand rather than the general reservation percentage.

accepted.s: The Gender Budget for 2026–27 was stated to be approximately:
o: ₹6.10 lakh crore, constituting 12.37 per cent
₹4.50 lakh crore, constituting 8.25 per cent
₹3.01 lakh crore, constituting 5.37 per cent
₹5.01 lakh crore, constituting 9.37 per cent
accepted.x: The Gender Budget for 2026–27 was ₹5.01 lakh crore, amounting to 9.37 per cent.
accepted.tq: Match the amount and percentage as a pair; changing either figure makes the option incorrect.

accepted.s: Which of the following is identified as a criticism of the present framework of women’s political representation?
o: It delays women’s legislative quota until post-Census delimitation and does not provide an OBC-women sub-quota.
It provides an OBC-women sub-quota in every legislature.
It excludes women from all Panchayat institutions.
It permits proxy representation only in Parliament.
accepted.x: The criticisms include delay of the women’s quota until post-Census delimitation, proxy representation, and the absence of an OBC-women sub-quota.
accepted.tq: Find the option combining the stated criticisms and reject claims that reverse the position.
